rxGroups.name: Humira (Adalimumab)
rxGroups.desc: TNF inhibitor for primary autoimmune condition. Started 2020, EOW since July 2025.

rxGroups.name: Olumiant (Baricitinib)
rxGroups.desc: JAK inhibitor. 2mg May-Sept 2025, 4mg since Dec 2025; resumed 2026-06-28 after about a 1-month gap; stop about 1-2 weeks before active TTC.

rxGroups.name: Rosuvastatin + Ezetimibe
rxGroups.desc: Statin + absorption blocker for APOE4. Rosuvastatin hold remains an open cardiologist conversation only if DFI is elevated.

rxGroups.name: Chlorthalidone
rxGroups.desc: Thiazide for hypercalciuria, 12.5mg daily since 2026-02-26 and never actually stopped (owner confirmed 2026-07-26; the prior 'on hold' record was wrong). Because it kept running through the D3/K2 protocol, that protocol does not isolate a single variable and its urine-calcium readout reflects thiazide plus D3/K2 together.

rxGroups.name: Finasteride
rxGroups.desc: 5-alpha reductase inhibitor for alopecia. Started Dec 2025; off indefinitely through TTC/DFI window, with 3-month washout targeting Sept 1 2026 DFI.

rxGroups.name: Supplements
rxGroups.desc: 5-MTHF, Fish Oil, D3+K2, CoQ10, Mg, Copper (planned/restart status unconfirmed).

heart.name: Heart
heart.context: Lipid transport and cardiovascular function. APOE e3/e4 carrier. Coronary calcium 0 at age 41. Rosuvastatin 20mg + ezetimibe 10mg. Aggressive targets: LDL <70, ApoB <80, non-HDL <100.

liver.name: Liver
liver.context: Hepatocellular integrity, biliary flow and synthetic function. Gilbert's syndrome (chronic elevated bilirubin, benign). Statin hepatotoxicity surveillance; ALT is the key enzyme to watch.

kidneys.name: Kidneys
kidneys.context: Glomerular filtration, electrolyte and acid-base handling, and renal excretion. Idiopathic hypercalciuria with a confirmed CLDN14 variant. Calcium oxalate stone history. Chlorthalidone 12.5mg daily since 2026-02-26.

bone.name: Bone
bone.context: Bone turnover and the vitamin D axis. VDR Bsm variant plus genotyped CYP24A1 and CYP2R1. Annual DEXA on Lunar Prodigy. Vitamin D target 50-70 ng/mL.

blood.name: Blood
blood.context: Haematopoiesis, immune cell lines, iron status and systemic inflammation. HFE S65C carrier. Dual immunosuppression (Humira + Olumiant) suppresses counts. ANC hard floor 1.5.

endocrine.name: Endocrine
endocrine.context: Hormonal axes and metabolic regulation. Testosterone declining with age, DHEA-S dropping. Finasteride held through the TTC/DFI washout. Thyroid stable. Body composition tracked as a metabolic-hormonal signal.

brain.name: Brain
brain.context: Risk lens, not an organ system: every marker here is measured for another system and read again for brain risk. APOE e3/e4 plus MTHFR/COMT/MAO-A context, lipid burden, glycemic stability, vitamin D and heavy-metal neurotoxicity.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.context: Recovery lens over Oura device series. Oura ring since Dec 2019. ~3 years consistent wear. Sleep quality, breathing, oxygenation, steps, HRV, and resting heart rate are recovery metrics for autoimmune management.

definitions.autoimmune-vasculitis: Rare autoimmune disease: vessel inflammation, ulcers, eye disease.
definitions.gilbert's: Benign inherited elevated bilirubin. No treatment needed.
definitions.apoe4: Gene variant impairing cholesterol clearance + Alzheimer's risk.
definitions.non-hdl: Total cholesterol minus HDL; a practical view of atherogenic cholesterol burden.
definitions.mthfr: Gene for folate metabolism. C677T variant reduces efficiency ~35%.
definitions.comt: Enzyme breaking down dopamine. Slow COMT = higher dopamine.
definitions.dopamine: Neurotransmitter for motivation and focus. Builds up with slow COMT.
definitions.serotonin: Mood neurotransmitter. High MAO-A clears it faster.
definitions.humira: Adalimumab — TNF inhibitor for autoimmune conditions.
definitions.olumiant: Baricitinib — JAK inhibitor for autoimmune conditions.
definitions.ezetimibe: Cholesterol absorption blocker in gut. Paired with statins.
definitions.chlorthalidone: Thiazide diuretic reducing urinary calcium loss. For kidney stones.
definitions.finasteride: Blocks testosterone to DHT conversion. For hair loss.
definitions.ochratoxin: Nephrotoxic mycotoxin from molds. Kidney/immune damage.
definitions.mycotoxin: Toxic mold compound causing organ/immune damage.
